title: Saturday Delivery Surcharge — Home Delivery Pharmacy Carrier Surcharge Schedule
content:
## Carrier surcharge schedule: Saturday delivery

**Schedule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy expedited order, a Saturday-delivery surcharge is added for the carrier's weekend handling: 8.00 when the member asked for overnight shipping and the order shipped on a Friday, 4.00 when the member asked for two-day shipping and the order shipped on a Thursday, and nothing in every other case. The surcharge is added to the expedited fee charged on that order.

"Asked for" means the shipping method recorded on the placed order; "shipped on" means the weekday of the ship date on the order's shipment record.

### Surcharge table

| Method asked for on the placed order | Weekday of the ship date | Saturday-delivery surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Overnight | Friday | 8.00 |
| Overnight | any other weekday | none |
| Two-day | Thursday | 4.00 |
| Two-day | any other weekday | none |
| Any other method | any weekday | none |

### Both sides of each pairing (hypothetical shipments)

- Overnight asked for, shipped Friday: 8.00. Overnight asked for, shipped Thursday: nothing.
- Two-day asked for, shipped Thursday: 4.00. Two-day asked for, shipped Friday: nothing.

The surcharge reflects the carrier handling a delivery that falls on a Saturday: an overnight shipment leaving on a Friday, or a two-day shipment leaving on a Thursday.
